name: gatk_dbsnp138
description: dbSNP build 138 as the Broad distributes it in the GATK resource bundle for hg38 (Homo_sapiens_assembly38.dbsnp138.vcf.gz), published by the Broad Institute. Known variants for base quality score recalibration and for annotating calls with rsIDs.

hg38.naming: UCSC: chr1, chr2, chrX, as in the Broad's Homo_sapiens_assembly38.fasta. Fits that genome and a UCSC-named GRCh38 analysis set; not an Ensembl or NCBI-named one.
